functions.name: freeware_aim_screen_global_init_thunk
functions.evidence: Startup table entry directly jumps to the screen-aim initializer.

functions.name: freeware_aim_screen_global_init
functions.evidence: Stores 320.0 and 240.0 in the two members of the verified freeware_aim_screen global.

functions.name: config_init_defaults_thunk
functions.evidence: Startup entry that jumps to the game config initializer.

functions.name: config_init_defaults
functions.evidence: Initializes the persisted config record used by freeware_save_config, including its display settings and both players’ bindings.

functions.name: sprite_effect_alloc_slot
functions.evidence: Called by fx_spawn_sprite to scan the 256 sprite-effect records.

functions.name: freeware_score_key_init
functions.evidence: Fills the 243-byte key table from game mode, player count and byte index.

functions.name: freeware_score_encode
functions.evidence: Adds the repeating 243-byte key to the payload and appends its weighted checksum.

functions.name: freeware_score_decode
functions.evidence: Subtracts the same repeating key and tests the weighted checksum stored after the payload.

functions.name: freeware_score_table_global_init_thunk
functions.evidence: Jumps directly to the static score table initializer.

functions.name: freeware_score_table_global_init
functions.evidence: Constructs the 100 score records with default name 10tons, using the same table as the loader.

functions.name: freeware_score_table_reset
functions.evidence: Called by the score loader before fopen. Visits all 100 score records, assigns the default name and clears scores.

functions.name: perks_init_database
functions.evidence: Registers every named perk ID, the perks01 atlas, frame number, title and wrapped description.

functions.name: game_frame_update
functions.evidence: The compiled dispatcher covers the complete pinned body. All seven interior discovery starts are switch destinations. The adjacent jump tables are outside its code extent.

functions.name: freeware_editor_offset_destroy
functions.evidence: The editor registers this no-op at exit when initializing its local static two-component offset to (0,0). Arrow-key handling updates the two components.

functions.name: freeware_draw_loading_progress
functions.evidence: WinMain calls this with successive progress fractions between asset loads. It draws the Crimsonland logo and a bullet-textured progress bar before presenting the frame.

functions.name: game_highscores_update
functions.evidence: Draws the Highscores: heading, mode labels -SURVIVAL-- and -CAREER----, and rows of the original score table through Grim.

functions.name: crimsonland_main
functions.evidence: The CRT entry calls this four-argument WinMain at 0x0041ca2b with GetModuleHandleA(NULL) and the startup command line. It opens Grim, loads resources and tears down the game; ret 0x10 releases its four arguments.

functions.name: msvc6_vector_pointer_size
functions.evidence: VC6's compiled std::vector pointer specialization matches the entire native callee, including the complete extent and every instruction outside relocation operands. Level file loading calls it with its native vector.

functions.name: msvc6_vector_pointer_destroy_range
functions.evidence: VC6 /O2 <vector> object and trigger pointer specializations match this entire folded helper at both native push_back call sites.

functions.name: msvc6_vector_pointer_insert_count
functions.evidence: VC6's compiled std::vector pointer specialization matches the entire native callee, including the complete extent and every instruction outside relocation operands. Level file loading calls it with its native vector.

functions.name: msvc6_vector_pointer_uninitialized_copy
functions.evidence: VC6 /O2 <vector> object and trigger pointer specializations match this entire folded helper at both native push_back call sites.

functions.name: msvc6_vector_pointer_uninitialized_fill
functions.evidence: VC6 /O2 <vector> object and trigger pointer specializations match this entire folded helper at both native push_back call sites.

functions.name: msvc6_vector_pointer_construct
functions.evidence: VC6 /O2 <vector> object and trigger pointer specializations match this entire folded helper at both native push_back call sites.

functions.name: effect_render_all
functions.note: Freeware effect draw pass, including pickup labels, particle sprites, bomb creature damage, rocket shock waves and smoke.

functions.name: Direct3DCreate8
functions.evidence: WinMain supplies SDK version 220 at 0x419d67. This indirect JMP uses the Direct3DCreate8 IAT slot at 0x4270e8 in d3d8.dll.

functions.name: crt_srand
functions.evidence: The QueryPerformanceCounter seed is stored in the same DWORD that crt_rand updates with the VC6 LCG immediately following this routine.

data.name: freeware_shadows
data.evidence: Gates the first creature render pass. The graphics preset modifies this byte at 0x415f59; the low-performance fallback clears it at 0x417cb5.

data.name: aim64_texture
data.evidence: The preceding Grim cache lookup requests aim64.

data.name: world_arrow_marker_texture
data.evidence: The preceding Grim cache lookup requests arrow, loaded from arrow.tga.

data.name: s_empty_string
data.evidence: Sets Grim config slot 0x10 to the empty string after the PAQ-backed loads.

data.name: freeware_main_labels
data.evidence: Seven pointers cleared before strdup-owned title menu labels are assigned.

data.name: freeware_option_labels
data.evidence: Eleven pointers cleared before strdup-owned option menu labels are assigned.

data.name: freeware_assembly_sequence
data.evidence: For August 1 through 4, initialize the assembly sequence to eight.

data.name: freeware_birthday
data.evidence: The September 12 branch sets the birthday byte to one.

data.name: ?insert@?$vector@PAUfreeware_level_object@@V?$allocator@PAUfreeware_level_object@@@std@@@std@@QAEXPAPAUfreeware_level_object@@IABQAU3@@Z
data.evidence: Pushes one pointer to a newly allocated 48-byte brush into freeware_brushes. VC6 emits this shared insert(pos, count, value) specialization.

data.name: screenshot_file_index
data.evidence: F12 formats screenshot_%i.bmp and increments the index only on successful save.

data.name: freeware_mouse_dx
data.evidence: The Grim horizontal mouse delta at vtable offset 0x60 is stored here and added to freeware_aim_screen.x.

data.name: freeware_xp_timer
data.evidence: The passive XP countdown subtracts frame_dt, resets to 0.25 and awards the Lean Mean Exp Machine perk at expiration.

data.name: freeware_configuring
data.evidence: The options option label chooses Player 1 vs Player 2 from this integer, which then indexes the two movement/aim schemes.

data.name: freeware_show_fps
data.evidence: The boolean selects between the Show FPS: on/off option strings.

data.name: freeware_menu_selected
data.evidence: The keyboard selection controls the secondary row highlight and is incremented/decremented with the two arrow-key edge queries.

data.name: freeware_options_open
data.evidence: Selects the options rows versus main rows when the setup prompts are inactive.

data.name: freeware_editor_init_flags
data.evidence: The lazy local-static initialization tests bit 0 and registers its existing no-op exit routine.

data.name: freeware_editor_offset
data.evidence: Lazy initialization zeros two floats; cursor arrow adjustments address x and y.

data.name: freeware_editor_brush
data.evidence: Minus and plus decrement/increment the selected brush index.

data.name: freeware_editor_rotation
data.evidence: Page Up subtracts the current frame interval from the editor rotation.

data.name: freeware_editor_layer
data.evidence: The three number keys select layer 0, 1, or 2; the result is later passed to add_object.

data.name: freeware_editor_light
data.evidence: Insert/Delete without left Shift adjust grayscale lightness.

data.name: freeware_editor_alpha
data.evidence: Insert/Delete while holding left Shift adjust alpha.

data.name: freeware_editor_radius
data.evidence: A increases the trigger radius by ten times the frame duration; new type-0 triggers receive that radius.

data.name: freeware_camera_timer
data.evidence: The frame callback subtracts frame_dt from this float, then resets it to the fixed shake period before the camera RNG draws.

data.name: freeware_fps_count
data.evidence: FPS statistics increment this index and use its remainder modulo 50 to write freeware_fps immediately afterward.
